diag_armyworm_desc: Sekgwa se ja matlakala a mafele, se tloša makgoba le senyareto se swanago le lerole.
diag_armyworm_action: Lekola masimo go sa thoma tša bošego. Hlatswa mahlo a mafi. Fafang ka mafelela ge koswi di sa gola.
dose_armyworm_cap: Kganya 2 dikhotikhoti tša calo ka 15 L sprayer.
diag_blight_desc: Bolwetši bjo bakišago maswantle a serolane le a bohlabela goba kgauswi.
diag_blight_action: Tloša matlakala a tshwerwego. Se šome masimong ge matlakala a metsi. Fetošetša semela se sengoa selemong se latelago.
dose_blight_copper: Kganya 3 dikhotikhoti tša calo ya kopore ka 15 L sprayer.
log_saved_offline: Bolokilwe go se nang inthanete. Tla latelwa ge go khutla inthanete.
log_empty: Ga go na dinlha tša pele.
